items.title: Thinking Machines Lab 发布可跑在笔记本上的开源权重模型 Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab 发布采用循环 Transformer 架构的开源模型 Inkling 2 Mini，该模型总参数 26.4B、激活 3.4B，内存占用约 20GB，可在 32GB 内存以上的 Mac 本地运行。其在 DeepSWE v1.1 和 Vals Index v2.2 基准上领先所有总参数量低于 100B 的开源权重模型，且在斯坦福“每焦耳智能”测试中以 0.703 的得分显著优于 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（0.430）和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B（0.159），实现本地硬件上运行多个常驻智能体的高效率与高性能。
items.why_now_en: Now: 20GB open model runs on your laptop
items.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab released the open-weights model Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B parameter Mixture of Experts model utilizing a recurrent Transformer architecture that runs its middle 12 layers three times per token to enhance reasoning without extending chain-of-thought verbosity. With only 3.4B active parameters and a 20GB memory footprint, it runs locally on 32GB RAM consumer laptops in NVFP4/MXFP8 precision, achieving 48.2% on DeepSWE v1.1 to lead all open models under 100B total parameters. The model demonstrates superior energy efficiency, scoring 0.703 in Stanford's "intelligence per watt" metric on an NVIDIA DGX Spark, significantly outperforming comparable Qwen and Gemma models.

items.title: Anthropic 破纪录 IPO 未能止住 AI 抛售，全球股市下挫
items.summary: Anthropic 于 11 月 19 日以每股 $83 的发行价登陆纳斯达克，开盘价冲高至 $111，但上市次日股价跌逾 9% 至 $88.17，未能阻止 AI 板块抛售。受此影响，周五 Nasdaq 跌 2%，SanDisk 和 Micron 分别下跌 14% 和 10%，亚洲股市创 2020 年以来最差单周表现，其中 SoftBank 单日暴跌 14.5%，台湾加权指数跌 6.7%。分析师指出，此次下跌反映了市场因流动性抽水导致的 AI 相关公司集中抛售。
items.why_now: Anthropic上市次日股价跌破发行价，引发全球AI板块连锁抛售。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's record-breaking IPO failed to stabilize the AI sector, with its stock dropping over 9% to $88.17 on day two—nearing its $83 issuance price—triggering a broader global sell-off. This decline saw the Nasdaq fall 2% and Asian markets post their worst week since 2020, with the weighted index falling 6.7% and SoftBank plunging 14.5% in a single day.

items.title: 昇腾算力训出了双榜SOTA的具身世界模型，华为云这次想把整套底座开放出来
items.summary: 华为云发布基于昇腾算力训练的具身世界模型CloudRobo-WM1.2，该模型采用PPA多模态世界表征架构与DualAct双路径协同设计，在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Pro 2.0两项评测中以88.98%和81.73%的平均成功率双双夺得榜首，真机测试中平均成功率较第二名高出23个百分点。该模型通过软硬件协同优化实现“昇腾原生”训练，将强化学习框架RLinf适配至昇腾NPU后，使GR00T N1.5/N1.6单位时间内动作计算量增加195%至278%，推理效率和训练吞吐提升约2至3倍。华为云计划于11月30日开源该模型的权重、推理及后训练代码，并接入20个数据源、33种本体，支持2.75万小时训练数据的高效利用。
items.why_now: 11月30日开放全代码，独立开发者可借力免搭链路快速试水具身模型。
items.summary_en: 华为云于11月16日发布昇腾原生的具身世界模型CloudRobo-WM1.2，该模型在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Pro 2.0两项评测中均以88.98%和81.73%的平均成功率位列双榜第一。作为全球首个基于国产昇腾算力完成端到端软硬件协同优化的具身模型，其计划于11月30日全面开源模型权重、推理及后训练代码，并凭借PPA多模态架构与DualAct双路径设计，在2.75万小时多源数据训练中实现了显存效率提升及推理速度2至3倍的增长。

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary: Inkling 2 Mini 是一款基于循环 Transformer 架构的混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数量 26.4B（激活 3.4B），采用 NVFP4/MXFP8 量化，内存占用仅约 20GB，可在 MacBook Pro 等消费级笔记本离线运行，并能在数分钟内构建可玩飞行模拟器。作为 100B 参数以下开源权重模型中的性能榜首，其在 DeepSWE v1.1 基准测试中得分 48.2%，在 Vals Index v2.2 中得分 46.5%，且通过循环推理机制在保持思维链可读性的同时提升了长时程智能体编码能力。
items.why_now: 今日开源Inkling 2 Mini，MacBook即可本地跑48.2%代码基准。
items.why_now_en: New 20GB model runs agentic coding locally on laptops.
items.summary_en: Inkling 2 Mini is a 26.4B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 3.4B active parameters and a looped transformer architecture that runs middle layers three times per token, achieving 48.2% on DeepSWE v1.1 to lead all open-weights models under 100B parameters. With a ~20GB memory footprint optimized for NVFP4 deployment, it runs offline on consumer laptops, significantly outperforming competitors in intelligence per joule (0.703 on NVIDIA DGX Spark vs. 0.430 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) while maintaining legible chains of thought for better monitorability.

items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.summary: 一个开源的27B语言模型通过自身的推理能力直接重写权重实现自我改进，无需梯度计算或重新训练，其编辑后的模型在未见过的测试问题上准确率提升了6.6分。该模型还能修复自身受损副本，在无法读取原始权重的情况下使其在图像任务上的准确率恢复至原模型的80%以上。这一“自重写”能力随模型规模增大而显现，区别于测试时扩展，它将性能增益永久写入权重，消除了训练与推理之间的界限，被视为通向递归自我改进的关键一步。
items.why_now: 11月16日发布首次LM自改写权重研究，开源27B模型无需训练即可自我进化。
items.why_now_en: New 27B open model self-rewrites weights without training
items.summary_en: An open 27B-parameter language model demonstrates "self-rewriting" by using its own reasoning to edit its internal weights without gradients or external training, achieving a 6.6-point accuracy gain on unseen problems. The model also repairs a damaged copy of itself, restoring over 80% of its original image-task accuracy, a capability that emerges only in the largest models within a specific family. This method writes improvements directly into the weights via forward passes, offering a persistent upgrade path distinct from temporary inference-time scaling.

items.title: Quoting Levent Alpöge
items.summary: 数学家Levent Alpöge声称他与AI模型Claude共同发现了黎曼猜想的证明，该方法不仅能解决广义黎曼猜想，还预计可进一步推广至扩展黎曼猜想，且双方已将论证过程形式化。这一进展标志着AI在高等数学研究中展现出超越人类研究者的能力，Claude在解题后期表现出的速度远超人类学者。
items.why_now_en: AI claims to prove the Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary_en: Levent Alpöge claims that he has discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis using Claude, a generative AI model developed by Anthropic, stating that the method also resolves the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and can be extended to the Extended Riemann Hypothesis. He notes that the arguments have been formalized without assumptions and describes Claude's performance near the end of the process as having "far outpaced" his own.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: 该工具是支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 等主流 Agent 的 diagram-design 技能，能生成无阴影、非 Mermaid 的自包含 HTML+SVG 图表，涵盖 51 种图类型。用户可通过 npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design 安装，并以自然语言指令（如“绘制包含前端、后端的架构图”或“拉取网站字体匹配品牌”）让 Agent 自动规划并输出可直接双击打开的单文件图表。
items.why_now_en: Cross-agent skill now targets major IDEs
items.summary_en: cathrynlavery/diagram-design is an agent skill that generates 45 to 51 types of custom, self-contained HTML + SVG diagrams for AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It installs via the `npx skills add` command and can import brand palettes from any website to ensure consistent visual output without using Mermaid. The tool is published by LittleMight, with Claude Code offering native plugin updates while other hosts use a standalone skills CLI that supports symlinked installations for multi-agent environments.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: 这款名为 last30days-skill 的 AI agent 技能通过并行搜索 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 等 6 大平台，利用点赞数和真实资金博弈作为评分标准，由 AI 合成过去 30 天的接地气的信息摘要。与传统 Google 聚合编辑观点不同，它突破平台数据孤岛限制，能够实时抓取如 Peter Steinberger 加入 OpenAI、提交 23 个 PR 等具体动态及社区实时反馈。安装该技能只需在 Claude Code 或 npx 中执行一条命令，零配置即可使用 Reddit 和 HN，运行一次后向导即可在 30 秒内解锁 X、YouTube 等付费或需鉴权数据源。
items.why_now_en: Free multi-platform agent research tool launches now.
items.summary_en: The mvanhorn/last30days-skill is an AI agent search tool that synthesizes data from Reddit, X, YouTube, Polymarket, and other platforms into a grounded summary, scoring results by user engagement metrics like upvotes and real-money odds rather than editorial curation. It operates via a parallel search architecture that bridges disconnected API walled gardens, allowing users to query recent trends across millions of user-generated interactions in a single pass. Installation is supported through Claude Code plugin marketplaces or global npx commands for over 50+ AI agents, with zero-config immediate access to Reddit and Hacker News alongside a 30-second setup wizard for unlocking additional sources.

items.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
items.summary: 开源工具 App Store Compliance 提供了一套包含 117 种被拒模式及修复方案的自动化合规守卫，并整合了 95 个关键法规（如欧盟 AI Act、DSA）截止日期追踪功能。开发者可通过克隆仓库并运行 `bash agent-os/hooks/app-store-compliance-guard.sh` 命令，在应用提交前扫描 Xcode 或 Android 项目，自动识别并定位导致苹果或谷歌拒审的隐私清单及数据安全风险。
items.why_now: 集成EU AI Act等95项合规期限，助开发者规避应用商店拒审。
items.summary_en: Open-source project app-store-compliance provides a pre-submission guard and playbook containing 117 documented rejection patterns, 95 tracked regulatory deadlines, and automated checks for privacy manifests and data safety to prevent App Store and Google Play rejections. The tool requires no installation or app modification, running via two simple bash commands to scan native code and Expo configurations in under a minute, identifying critical risks such as broken demo accounts and mismatched privacy declarations before submission.

items.title: 双系统决策+双层自进化，Agnes让Agent效率最高提速14倍，成本骤降至1/27！
items.summary: 开源系统 Agnes Harness（GitHub 2.1k Star）通过引入 9B 决策模型 Agnes Sys1.0 构建“快慢双脑”机制，使高频操作推理速度提升 14.3 倍，单次决策成本降至在线大模型的 1/27（0.000091 美元 vs 0.00247 美元）。结合 TTT 测试时训练与 RSI 递归自我改进，该系统将复杂设备入库验收任务的执行时间从 30 分钟缩短至 8 分钟以内，并通过 MHS 模型硬件标准实现机械臂等物理设备的统一接入与任务拆分。
items.topic: AI 工具实操 / Agent 工作流
items.why_now: Agnes Harness刚开源，独立开发者可直接低成本部署，无需等待竞品降价或政策利好。
items.why_now_en: Open-sourced now; cuts Agent adaptation costs 1/27.
items.summary_en: The open-source Agnes Harness system utilizes a dual-system decision architecture pairing a 9B Agnes Sys1.0 model with a large language model, reducing decision latency by 14.3x and cost to 1/27 for simple tasks while accelerating robotic navigation efficiency by 32.9%. It implements Test-Time Training for rapid task adaptation and Recursive Self-Improvement to log execution errors into versioned playbooks, cutting complex equipment validation time from 30 minutes to under 8 minutes. Additionally, the framework supports hardware integration via the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) and plugin-based workflows, enabling local deployment on Node.js 24.10 without requiring a GPU.

items.title: Output tokens are 17% of the volume and 50% of the bill — a year of Gemini 4 Neon vs Claude Opus 5.5
items.why_now: Opus 5.5未公布缓存价格且Fast档翻倍，2026年11月新费率下选型需立即校准。
items.summary_en: On a fixed workload of 10M input and 2M output tokens per month, output tokens constitute only 17% of the volume but 50% of the bill because API providers price output at exactly 5× the input rate, making the output-to-input ratio the primary cost driver. Gemini 4 Neon costs $720/year for this workload, compared to $960 for Claude Opus 5.5 and $1,920 for its fast tier, while GPT-6.2 Sol is the most economical at $480/year. Additionally, cached input rates significantly lower costs (e.g., dropping Neon's input cost from $30 to $7.20 with 80% cache hits), but comparisons are skewed when vendors like Anthropic do not publish cached-input pricing.

items.why_now: Firecrawl Local开源，免费替代竞品，本地运行即刻赋能Agent。
items.summary_en: Firecrawl provides knowledge infrastructure for AI agents through three deployment modes: a self-contained Rust-based Local binary, a Cloud service, and self-hosted server options. Firecrawl Local runs on localhost via `cargo install firecrawl-local`, supports JavaScript rendering and document parsing, and acts as an MCP server for tools like Claude Code and Cursor. The Cloud service extends capabilities with access to 550+ data providers through the Firecrawl Alexandria search platform and advanced features like structured JSON extraction and automated agents.

items.summary: Park 是一款用 Go 语言编写的单二进制工具，它通过本地 SQLite 数据库（默认位于 ~/.local/share/park/park.db）帮助开发者和 AI 代理跨仓库及多设备保存并检索工作上下文。用户可通过 `park add` 命令记录任务的关键要素（如名称、原因、具体代码位置及标签），并利用 `park list` 和 `park search` 进行全量或局部检索，同时支持通过 `--parent` 参数将子任务关联至里程碑以追踪进度，从而实现工作流的持久化与恢复。

items.summary: Anthropic数学家Levent Alpöge与Claude合作宣称找到黎曼猜想证明，通过串联theta提升变换生成14个Lean压缩包供核查，菲尔兹奖得主陶哲轩回应称该成果尚待独立验证。华为子品牌OSTA发布首款阔直板手机O1 Pro，售价5499元起，搭载麒麟9030S芯片及7000mAh电池；余承东同日更正享界V8表述，强调目前仅提供L2级辅助驾驶功能。零跑汽车三季度全球交付约31万辆创历史新高，但受成本上升影响，归母净利润降至4000万元，毛利率由14.5%降至10.9%。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have used Claude to formulate a Lean formalized proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, a result currently under independent verification with Field Medalist Terence Tao noting it requires significant time to digest. In automotive news, Huawei CEO Richard Yu corrected earlier L3 autonomous driving claims, clarifying that the new Xiangjie V8 only supports L2 assistance, while OSTA released its first smartphone, the O1 Pro, starting at 5,499 yuan. Additionally, Zero Run’s Q3 global deliveries hit a record 310,000 units with revenue of 31.7 billion yuan, and Lingjun Labs’ Pragmatik Labs secured new funding at a 5 billion dollar valuation.

items.title: MiniMax 内部模型 MIM 实现多项密码分析实用攻击并开源验证轨迹
items.summary: MiniMax 团队利用内部模型 MIM 对 NIST 候选算法、同行评审方案及公开挑战基准执行自动化密码分析，实现了此前无实用攻击方案的首个实用破解，并将部分理论攻击转化为可执行攻击。
items.summary_en: MiniMax's internal model MIM achieved the first practical attacks on modern cryptographic schemes, successfully breaking NIST candidate algorithms, peer-reviewed ciphers, and public challenge benchmarks that previously lacked viable exploits. The system converted theoretical cryptographic weaknesses into executable attacks and has open-sourced its verification trajectories to support the findings.

items.title: MIT 数学面板讨论 AI 冲击下的数学研究未来
items.summary: OpenAI 曾部署数千个 AI 智能体，耗时 88 小时攻克纳维-斯托克斯方程这一千禧年难题，并在随后发布了 722 份由 AI 生成的数学手稿，引发学界对“数学末日”的广泛讨论。面对 AI 证明缺乏人类理解逻辑的现状，数学家 Bryna Kra 指出评估标准正从追求优先权转向重视阐述清晰度，学术期刊如《Mathematical Discourse》已增设视频评审机制，以突出人类在数学沟通与创造性解读上的独特优势。
items.summary_en: MIT convened a panel featuring mathematicians from Harvard, Northwestern, and NYU to discuss how AI agents are fundamentally reshaping mathematical research, highlighted by OpenAI’s recent publication of 722 AI-generated manuscripts solving open problems and a millennial-prize challenge on Navier-Stokes equations. The discussion highlighted critical shifts in academic norms, such as de-prioritizing discovery speed (priority) in favor of human comprehension and expository clarity, prompting journals like *Mathematical Discourse* to value "explanation" over raw proofs. Key figures noted that while AI has achieved gold-medal performance in Olympiads, the field is now pivoting to a "new type of mathematician" who leverages AI tools for insight while maintaining the human skill of communicating complex mathematical concepts.

directions.name: AI合规雷达
directions.description: 自动监控AI模型供应商（如Anthropic, OpenAI）的条款变更与IPO动态，为B端用户提供合规风险预警与影响评估。
directions.description_en: Automatically monitors terms of service and IPO dynamics of AI model providers (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) to provide compliance risk alerts and impact assessments for B2B users.
directions.target_user: 使用第三方大模型API的法务、合规团队及SaaS产品负责人
directions.target_user_en: Legal, compliance teams, and SaaS product owners using third-party LLM APIs
core_features: 自动抓取并解析模型供应商ToS与政策更新
基于NLP生成合规影响摘要与行动建议
针对IPO等商业变动生成财务与数据主权风险评估
core_features_en: Auto-scrape and parse TOS and policy updates from model providers
Generate compliance impact summaries and action items using NLP
Generate financial and data sovereignty risk assessments for business changes like IPOs
directions.why_now: Anthropic IPO（史上最大规模）及多源报道的热度表明AI核心资产正在从纯技术转向重监管、重资本的市场环境。社区（Reddit/HN）中关于'API稳定性'和'数据隐私'的讨论激增，用户急需工具来量化供应商商业变动（如上市后的财报披露要求）对自家产品合规性的潜在冲击，而非仅仅关注模型能力。
directions.why_now_en: Anthropic's IPO (the largest ever) and cross-source coverage indicate the AI core asset is shifting from a pure tech to a heavily regulated, capital-intensive market environment. Community discussions on 'API stability' and 'data privacy' are surging; users urgently need tools to quantify the potential compliance impact of vendor commercial changes (such as post-IPO financial disclosure requirements) on their products, not just model capabilities.
directions.monetization: SaaS订阅制（按被监控供应商数量计费），并提供月度合规审计报告
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription (billed by number of monitored vendors) and monthly compliance audit reports
directions.source_article: Anthropic pulls off the biggest IPO ever
